meta.title: Fast bidding needs more than one line item

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event, published, with one QA vendor invited; bidding open for about 20 minutes.
steps: The buyer sends the request that converts a round into an auction, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “CBD mode requires at least two active line items. Please add more line items to continue.”, and never with a server error.

plan.title: Fast bidding needs more than one line item

expected.message: CBD mode requires at least two active line items. Please add more line items to continue.
